hints.title: Group Consecutive Duplicates
hints.text: Identify maximal blocks of identical characters and measure the length of each block.

hints.title: Count Run Lengths
hints.text: Use a frequency counter to tally how often each distinct run length occurs.

hints.title: Find Max Frequency
hints.text: Return the maximum frequency recorded among all run lengths.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning substrings results in quadratic time complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counter takes O(number of distinct run lengths) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects linear scan run-length extraction and frequency aggregation.
